title: Grim Painting in Rainy Room
description: A uniformed female officer stands in a dimly lit, rain-soaked room holding a cup, staring at a large ominous painting. The painting depicts a skeletal winged demon with an axe and a ghostly pale woman in a Victorian dress, both covered in blood with red liquid dripping from the frame onto the floor.
